info.title: Perp.ag Data API
info.description: Trader analytics for Lighter, RH Lighter, Jupiter, Phoenix, Bullet and Aftermath. API keys are issued on request: message @perp_ag on X.

get.description:
The leaderboard: every wallet on a venue with its 7D, 30D and all-time metrics, its Copy Score and a PnL chart, filtered and sorted. Paged with `page` and `limit`.

Each row carries a daily PnL chart, so large pages are slow. Ask for what you need.

get.description: The Copy Score of one wallet with its tier, sub-scores and style tags. A wallet without enough recent history returns null scores and an `eligibilityReason`.

copyability.description: How practical the wallet is to mirror, from frequency and sizing.

drawdown.description: Drawdown sub-score. Higher means shallower drawdowns.

consistency.description: Win rate and profit factor combined.

frequency.description: Lower when the wallet trades very often.

sizing.description: Lower when position sizes vary a lot.

confidence.description: How much trade history backs the score.

directionEdge.description: Which side the wallet makes money on.

data.description: Copy Score of a wallet. See the Metrics page for how it is computed.

get.description: Realized PnL of one wallet over time, per day, week, month or year, with running totals. Use it for a realized PnL chart; use Get equity curve to include open positions.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Bucket size.

date.description: Day (UTC), or the first day of the bucket.

pnl_delta.description: Realized PnL before fees in the bucket.

pnl_after_fee.description: Realized PnL after fees in the bucket.

transfer_amount_usd.description: Net collateral transferred in the bucket.

cumulative_pnl_after_fee.description: Running total of realized PnL after fees.

first_activity.description: First activity of the wallet (daily buckets only).

last_activity.description: Last activity of the wallet (daily buckets only).

get.description: Daily realized PnL, unrealized PnL and total equity of one wallet. The series starts no earlier than 2026-01-01, but `cumulative_pnl_after_fee` carries the full lifetime total. On Bullet, `unrealized_pnl` is 0 (realized only).

cumulative_pnl_after_fee.description: Lifetime realized PnL after fees up to this day.

unrealized_pnl.description: PnL of positions open at the end of the day.

get.description: Per-market wins, losses, win rate, long/short volume and realized PnL of one wallet, sorted by PnL (best first).
What one wallet holds right now, read live from the venue. On Phoenix a wallet can return several rows for one market, one per subaccount.

protocol.description: Venue, as in the protocol column of Venues and identifiers.

market_id.description: Venue market index, where the venue has one.

size.description: Position size in the base asset.

unrealisedPnl.description: PnL at the current mark price.

realisedPnl.description: PnL already realized on this position.

fundingUsd.description: Funding paid or received on the position.

marginType.description: Margin mode, where the venue reports it.

items.description: Open position. Fields a venue does not report are null or absent.

get.description: Every fill of one wallet (`view=trades`), or its positions from open to close (`view=positions`). Paged with `offset` and `limit`; keep going while `hasMore` is true.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Fills, or positions grouped from open to close.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Only this market symbol.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Only this side.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Only this fill type. buy and sell on order-book venues; increase, decrease and liquidation on Jupiter.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: From this time (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Up to this time (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: min_position_size_usd
parameters.description: Only fills on positions at least this large.

parameters.name: max_position_size_usd
parameters.description: Only fills on positions at most this large.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort column.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: Sort direction.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip.

action.description: Fill type: buy or sell on order-book venues; increase, decrease or liquidation on Jupiter.

pnl_delta.description: Realized PnL of this fill before fees.

liquidation_fee_usd.description: Liquidation fee, if the fill was a liquidation.

has_profit.description: Whether the fill realized a profit.

tx_id.description: Transaction hash or venue fill id.

cycle_key.description: Unique id of the position cycle.

status.description: Whether the position is still open.

leverage.description: Leverage, where the venue reports it.

fills_query.description: Parameters to pass back to this endpoint (view=trades) to list the cycle's fills.

oneOf.description: One position from open to close (view=positions).

total.description: Total rows, when cheap to count; otherwise null.

get.description: Money in and out of one wallet with totals. Lighter covers deposits, withdrawals, transfers and vault flows; Phoenix, Bullet and Aftermath cover deposits and withdrawals; RH Lighter and Jupiter return an empty list. Returns 502 when a venue read live does not answer.

l1_address.description: L1 address of a deposit or withdrawal.

route_type.description: Withdrawal route, for example fast or secure.

total.description: Total rows, when cheap to count; otherwise null.

get.description:
Every venue ranked over the last 7 complete UTC days against the 7 before: volume, traders, retention, open interest, fees and concentration, with 14 days of daily volume. Sorted by volume. Fills on order-book venues are counted once, so volumes compare fairly.

This endpoint takes no parameters.

volumeUsd.description: Volume in the last 7 days, each fill counted once.

volumeSharePct.description: Share of total volume across venues, percent.

prevTraders.description: Wallets that traded in the 7 days before.

newTraders.description: Wallets trading on the venue for the first time.

retainedPct.description: Share of the previous week's traders who traded again, percent.

top10Pct.description: Share of volume from the 10 biggest wallets, percent.

weeklyVolumeToOi.description: Weekly volume divided by open interest.

daily.description: 14 days of daily volume and traders.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Your API key. Keys are issued on request: message @perp_ag on X.

owner.name: owner
owner.description: The wallet: an account index on Lighter and RH Lighter, a Solana address on Jupiter, Phoenix and Bullet, an account object id (0x + 64 hex) on Aftermath.

range.name: range
range.description: Time range. 1M is 30 days, 3M 90 days, 1Y 365 days.
